ctx.x: Well, we had some people in there. We had Otto Kahn. We had Henry Bussey, we had some -- Miller and Lyle. And Florence Mills used to come in there. Danny Small. We had so many. Bechet would come in there. Bechet was nobody then, but he'd come in there. And we had all the performers there like Glenn and Jenkins, and all. Black performers and white performers. I don't recall Paul Whiteman ever coming in there, but all of his men used to come in there. And quite a lot of Vincent Lopez' boys used to come in there.
So, in other words, the clientele there was not just white.
